summary: Preserve URI scanning under local scratch and use a valid native Planfile owned status

delivery.outcome: Make URI scanning relative to the selected root, prune ignored trees before traversal and preserve the native owned-ticket negative test using a valid Planfile status.
nonGoals: No Planfile version relaxation, new skips, global dependency upgrade or deployed runtime change.

architecture.decision: Extract the existing URI scanner behind its unchanged public adapter into a small scanner module. Filter directories relative to the supplied root; ignore symlinked inputs and prune ignored descendants. Use the pinned native Planfile in_progress enum for an owned non-open ticket fixture; keep preservation assertions unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Revert only the bounded reviewed source change; no persistent data migration.

validation.evidence: Run actual affected tests in a project venv with pinned Planfile 0.1.126 and project-local scratch; retain all preservation and traversal negatives.
